sourceProjection.basis: The museum-published English guide sample uses direct overhead diagrams on pages 4 and 9. Page 9 prints the Palatine Gallery and Royal Apartments plan with all 29 room numbers; page 4 prints source-vector collection footprints for the second floor. The diagrams have independent scales and are not geometrically stacked.

The museum-published Spanish guide sample embeds the same direct-overhead Treasury ground and mezzanine diagram at 574 by 511 pixels, compared with 345 by 307 in the English sample. Parallel room walls, door breaks and identifiers 1-26 were visually checked at native pixels before tracing.

review: Gallerie degli Uffizi museum-shop guide samples published in 2018. The Spanish sample contains the same Treasury diagram at 574 by 511 pixels, about 2.8 times the pixel count of the English sample. Page 6 was inspected at native pixels, nearest-neighbour enlargement and high-contrast rendering. The earlier rectangular room surfaces and buffer-derived walls were rejected. Ground and mezzanine use only source-pixel channels: the pale blue plan field is mapped to a non-semantic surface with red capped at 247 so pure white cannot enter the mask; tight reviewed source-coordinate boxes restore the field only where printed numerals interrupt it; four-pixel mid-tone structural strokes are walls; and the corresponding dark numeral glyphs are excluded while surrounding door arcs, stairs and ornament remain flat detail. This preserves the irregular north extension, courtyard voids, narrow rooms and source door gaps without inventing room polygons. English pages 9 and 4 retain the reviewed first-floor plan and second-floor source-vector collection fills unchanged. Current official pages confirm broad collection levels, but a newer notice closes the Treasury from 3 February 2026 until further notice. The 2018 diagrams are historical spatial evidence, not live access maps.

limitations: 包含底层、夹层、一层和二层的历史平面；二层仅有馆区轮廓，尚缺逐室布局。
各层保持各自比例，楼梯与电梯的跨层连接尚未确认。
大公珍宝馆自 2026 年 2 月 3 日起维护关闭，恢复时间另行通知；建筑及房号仍保留展示。
internalNotes: 四幅图来自馆方2018年出版导览样张，比例彼此独立，仅按馆内层级分组显示，不表示测量配准或垂直井道对位。
底层与夹层采用馆方同版574×511像素原图；浅蓝色图面排除纯白后归为不可选择的来源地面，房号覆盖处只在逐一核定的小框内恢复地面，四像素厚度筛选后的中性结构线归为墙，1至26号原始数字字形逐一剔除，门扇弧线、楼梯和铺地图案仍保留为平面细节。
先前统一矩形房面和按房面外扩生成的墙体已经删除；在无法逐室确认完整内墙轮廓前，不生成底层与夹层的语义房间面，也不封闭原图门洞。
馆方较新的通知说明大公珍宝馆自2026年2月3日起因特别维护整体关闭，恢复时间另行通知；夹层参观此前亦标为暂停。本图仅保留历史建筑与编号证据，不声称目前开放。
二层分区依据馆方出版图中的精确矢量色块；冬季套房在该出版物中标为预约参观，其他馆区的现行开放与展陈仍须以馆方当天信息为准。
图源没有给出四幅独立图之间可验证的楼梯或电梯井配准，因此不生成推测性的跨层连接。
